itemCodeableConcept.description: The actual ingredient - either a substance (simple ingredient) or another medication.

strength.description: Specifies how many (or how much) of the items there are in this Medication.  For example, 250 mg per tablet.  This is expressed as a ratio where the numerator is 250mg and the denominator is 1 tablet.
